# dsh-report-fix
English | 简体中文

A DSH plugin: **a session whose turn was started by `session_call(task_dispatch)` cannot
close that
turn until it has sent a `task_report` back to the caller.**

It adds no tools and changes nothing inside `dsh-call-session`. It listens to three lifecycle
hooks

the DSH host already emits, checks the receipt at the turn boundary, and — when the
receipt is missi

ng — injects a fresh instruction message that re-opens the turn, forcing the
model to call `session_
call(call_type="task_report")`.
## The gap it closes
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`session_call` is delivery-only: a `task_dispatch` waits at most 300 ms for the handshake and
can ne

ver learn whether the callee reported back. This plugin closes that hole — a
dispatch-driven turn ca
n only end in a "reported" state.
## How it works
| Hook | When | What it does |
| `agent/pre-step` | before each step's messages reach the model | recognize inbound `task_dispatch`

, register the debt, append a reminder (optional) |
| `tools/post-execute` | after every tool call |

a successful `session_call(task_report)` clears the matching debt |
| `agent/turn-stopping` | the t
urn is about to close (final answer already produced) | if a debt remains, `agent.steer(message)`; t
he loop re-reads its inbox and runs another step instead of closing |

`agent/turn-stopping` is the only supported way to keep a turn open. The type comment in
`@deepseek-

ai/dsh-agent` says it plainly: *Awaited before the boundary commits — a listener
that objects steers

(agent.steer(...)) and the machine re-reads its inbox: fresh steering runs
another step, none close
s the turn.* This plugin uses exactly that path.
### How a turn is recognized as dispatch-driven
Every `session_call` delivery is a native user message with `source.kind = 'plugin:dsh-call-session'

`
and a transport header on its first line:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The turn counts as dispatch-driven when: `source.kind === 'plugin:dsh-call-session'`,
`source.form =

== 'notice'` (i.e. delivered by `session_call`, not by `session_create`), the
header parses, and `Ca

llType` is `task_dispatch`. Inbound `notice` / `task_report` messages
create no obligation.
### How a report is accepted
All of the following, in `tools/post-execute`:

- `exec.name === 'session_call'`
- `result.isError !== true` and `result.value.success === true`
- `

result.value.callType === 'task_report'`
- `result.value.targetSessionId` matches the caller (case-i

nsensitive; a unique prefix is
accepted because `session_call` itself supports prefix addressing)
### What the interception looks like
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Guard messages follow the inbound message's language (Chinese body → Chinese wording, otherwise
Engl
ish); `locale` overrides.
## Known limits

1. **The final text has already been produced and may already be visible.** `assistant/message`
is c

ommitted and streamed *before* `agent/turn-stopping` runs, so the guarantee is
"**the turn does not

end without a report**", not "the user never sees the unreported text".
The latter would need a host

hook before finalize; the current DSH version has none.
2. **Bounded interception.** When `maxNudge

s` (default 3) is spent, the turn is released and a
`warn` is logged, so a model stuck in a loop can

not pin the turn forever. `maxNudges: 0`
keeps only the reminder and disables the hard gate.
3. **Ob

ligations are per turn.** A new turn starts clean; a debt is never carried over.
4. **Only successfu

l `task_report`s count.** A tool error, `success: false`, or a report sent to
the wrong session does

not clear the debt.
5. **It follows `dsh-call-session`'s message format.** It imports none of that

package and only
reads `source.kind` / `source.form` / the first-line header, so a format change ups

tream
needs a matching update here.
6. Multiple callers in the same turn each get their own debt and

must each be reported to.
7. **Conflicting dispatch bodies are decided by the model.** If a `task_d

ispatch` body says
"do not report back", the model may side with it and burn the whole `maxNudges` b

udget before
the turn is released (observed in testing). The guard text states that its requirement

outranks such wording, which lowers the odds but does not remove them.
8. **Restart `dsh web` after

changing plugin source.** `dsh-hmr` watches the profile's
`package.json` and patch files, not the wo

rkspace directory behind a `link:` dependency, so
source edits are not reloaded automatically (cosme

tic text changes are the easiest to
misjudge as "already live").
## Configuration

Override by id in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`dsh-hmr` recomposes the profile, no restart
nee

n the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`dsh-hmr` recomposes the profile, no restart
needed for config):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | master switch; `false` registers no hooks at all |
| `maxNudges` | `3` | inte

rceptions per turn; `0` disables the hard gate and keeps the reminder |
| `preStepReminder` | `true`

| append a reminder on the first step, so most turns comply before the gate |
| `locale` | `auto` |

`auto` follows the inbound message language; `zh` / `en` force it |
| `excerptMaxChars` | `600` | m
ax characters of the original dispatch quoted in the nudge |
## Install

This is a DSH profile plugin (bundle shape): `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and
`cordis.
patch.yml` mounts the row with `- insert:`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
After `dsh plugin add`:

- `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` gains `dsh-report-fix` in `dsh.profile.bundles`;
- `dsh-hmr` wa

tches the profile's `package.json` and patch files and recomposes live, so the
plugin is active with

out restarting `dsh web`;
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility

- DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`
- Depends on the profile plugin `dsh-call-session` (message format onl

y, no version pin)
- Node `>=20`, zero runtime dependencies
